title: Session-end hook: report or release what the actor still holds
body: SessionStart is the only hook. Nothing runs when a session ends, so an agent that stops mid-issue leaves a claim to expire and a note log with no last entry. A Stop or SessionEnd hook could report what the actor still holds and heartbeat it, unclaim it, or refuse to end quietly. Turns 'unclaim what you leave' from a sentence in the contract into something the harness does. Depends on per-session actor identity to know whose claims are whose.
